answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in forge and tundra lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ridge graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1280 impostors cost 1961 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
